mapper.select: SELECT C.CERT_NO, C.CHALLENGE_NO, C.MEMBER_NO, C.CERT_TITLE, C.CERT_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(C.CERT_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CERT_WRITE_DATE, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG FROM CERT C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO WHERE C.CHALLENGE_NO = #{challengeNo} AND C.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY C.CERT_NO DESC

SELECT C.CERT_NO, C.CHALLENGE_NO, C.MEMBER_NO, C.CERT_TITLE, C.CERT_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(C.CERT_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CERT_WRITE_DATE, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG FROM CERT C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = C.MEMBER_NO WHERE C.CHALLENGE_NO = #{challengeNo} ORDER BY C.CERT_WRITE_DATE DESC
